title: They Perform The Inner Cleansing Practice
summary: Restlessness is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: They perform the inner cleansing practice with water and adopt the eighty-four Yogic postures; i have searched and searched, seeking the Blessed Vision of His Darshan
lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
